needs.what: The offspring {N} keyword (702.175): an optional additional cost paid as the creature spell is cast, and, if it was paid, an enters trigger creating a token copy of that permanent that is 1/1; plus a static effect that grants offspring {2} to creature spells its controller casts, on the stack, as they are cast
needs.why_existing_wont_do: offspring appears nowhere in the reference: not in keywords, card_level_cost_keys or static_effects. The closest cast-time grants, grant_warp and grant_miracle, give their own fixed mechanics to spells, and grant_keyword only reaches permanents, so neither can give a spell an optional additional cost that leaves a cast-time 'paid' flag for a 1/1 token-copy enters trigger to read
